name: Chronomancer: Rapid Acceleration raises Accelerated Recovery's healing scaling and heals 15% of it at once (#1163)
contract: Rapid Acceleration 570149 (Spell.dbc, family 28, passive) reads 'Increases the bonus healing scaling of Accelerated Recovery by $s1%. Your Accelerated Recovery instantly heals the target for $s2% of the total periodic effect.' with $s1 = $s2 = 15 (BasePoints 14 + DieSides 1). Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with class mask word1 0x10000000, the family flag of every Accelerated Recovery rank (800857, 501772-501778), and MiscValue 40, a private client spellmod index that AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod and Player::AddSpellMod discard because it is at least MAX_SPELLMOD. The client names that index itself: Weapon Empowerment 92857 '[Spell Power Direct]' uses op 24 and 92858 '[Spell Power DoT]' uses op 40, so op 40 is the percentage modifier of a periodic effect's spell power coefficient; Accelerated Recovery is a pure SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_HEAL, where this core's SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER (24) scales exactly that coefficient in Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone. Effect 1 is an unscripted SPELL_AURA_DUMMY. The client's Accelerated Recovery heal 804500 (SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL, same family flag, SPELL_ATTR3_TREAT_AS_PERIODIC) carries the instant heal as a resolved amount. Expected: with the talent, SPELLMOD_BONUS_MULTIPLIER for rank 8 (501778) is 1.15 times the control's (fails before the fix), and applying rank 8 (15000 ms, 1000 ms amplitude, 15 ticks) heals the target through 804500 for 15% of the tick amount times 15 ticks, i.e. 2.25 times one tick, while the control gets no such heal (fails before the fix). The per-tick spell power coefficient itself is not asserted: the shipped data carries none for Accelerated Recovery (EffectBonusMultiplier 0, no spell_bonus_data row in the repository), so the 15% applies to whatever coefficient the world database supplies.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Learning Rapid Acceleration applies its passive
The control's coefficient multiplier for Accelerated Recovery
DISCRIMINATING: the talent raises Accelerated Recovery's coefficient multiplier by 15%
The talented Chronomancer's Accelerated Recovery landed
Accelerated Recovery rank 8 runs 15 sec, so 15 one-second ticks
One tick of the talented caster's Accelerated Recovery
SETUP: the tick amount is positive
DISCRIMINATING: the instant heal is 15% of 15 ticks, 2.25 times one tick
The instant heal lands once per application
Let a would-be heal from the control's cast arrive
Without the talent Accelerated Recovery has no instant heal
